probe: filmed by hand: the step window shows and says each step and waits for you (say next / go / done, or Right Shift + 9); the clip ends after the last one. No game sound in the video: the spoken steps come out of the speakers the recorder listens to
title: Deployables Anywhere
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: place it where the game says no

hand.do: Shift+P and pick something big enough to see: a shed, a silo or a big sign
hand.why: Hold it over land you don't own, or where the game shows red. Keep the camera close.

hand.do: Hold it where it shows red
hand.why: Not your land, or in the way

caption.heading: The game says no
caption.text: Red: not your land, or something in the way.

hand.do: Press Ctrl+Shift+P, then click to place it

caption.heading: Free placement
caption.text: Ctrl+Shift+P, and it goes where you want it.

hand.do: Pick another big item; nudge it with Ctrl+Shift+Arrow keys

caption.heading: To the centimetre
caption.text: Ctrl+Shift+Arrows nudge it 10 cm; the first nudge locks it in place.

hand.do: Ctrl+Shift+PageUp/PageDown to raise or lower, Ctrl+Shift+, or . to turn it

caption.heading: Height and angle
caption.text: 5 cm up or down, 1 degree turns.

caption.heading: Placed
caption.text: Exactly there, at that height and angle.

hand.do: On a slope: Ctrl+Shift+G, then place something

caption.heading: No flattening
caption.text: Ctrl+Shift+G keeps the ground as it is.

hand.do: Press ESC to leave the construction menu
